top_clamp_access.note: Six vertical service bores for the existing clamp tightening screws; preserve all mounting holes. Driver envelope is provisional.

fastening_revision.note: Unprinted parts: exposed free nuts with open spanner access and through shafts; printed stock preserves legacy pockets.

clamp_support.note: Exposed nuts and nut-side washers at the full 8 mm foot; open axial-edge spanner relief, through shaft, M3x25/30 checked.

attachment_interface.note: Outside attachment, ordinary M3 nut inserted from inside; choose screw length for actual attachment thickness.

protection.rotation_key: Both existing end-cap tabs; independent open-top receivers bolted directly to the side frames
protection.symmetry: 180 degree reversal is not rejected; align the documented cap hole pattern at assembly
